author: IequalsS
text: Red Knight, great homework, I am now using this technique and keeping track of the numbers. will post later. I have a question, what do you mean when you rate zones as 0.5? does that mean there was a small reaction but it went through anyway?

author: Red Knight
text:
Hi LequalsS, Example.My DZ=50pips so if price react and move away before break zone at least 25 pips=0.5 I will 1.move SL to B/E 2.take some profits etc. Basically I will not take loss if price then pull back and break zone.

If price move less then 0.5 in this example=25 pips and break the zone that's mean no reaction from the zone=loss/hit SL

Reason why I work with this concept is b/c I will act in this way if I am in that trade.I know is static exercise so after the fact but still great exercise. All that No's are not exact as I didn't do it for this reason.These No's making more attractive this HW for me. I would like to say before when you start this HW just think about which way is more efective for you and how you can get most from this HW for your trading.It is better if you play with form of exercise before and not just copy what you see.Well at least I try it that way. Hope helps in some way.

author: IequalsS
text: That's awesome, I have a similar rule of moving to BE when I have 1:1 move away. Very important technique for minimising losses and maximising win loss ratio. Thanks for the great explanation
